title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Summary:
Payroll assistant needed for a busy administrative office at Ohio University in Athens, Ohio. Will assist with various tasks:
  • Organizing reports and spreadsheets related to payroll data
  • Building reports for payroll and payroll tax purposes for supervisor
  • Research and detailed review to balance/reconcile
  • Other general support tasks related to a busy payroll office
This is a temporary, full-time job opportunity, starting ASAP and lasting approximately two to three months. The schedule is 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday to Friday. Pay is commensurate with experience, within the range of $14 to $16/hour.

Qualifications:
Knowledge of payroll, finance or human resources is preferred. A high school degree or GED and at least 1 year of related work experience. An associate or bachelor's degree can be used in place of the one year of work experience.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Position Summary:
A local printing company located in Athens is seeking a hard-working employee to serve as customer service representative. Job duties will include, but are not limited to:
  • taking customer orders via phone, email, or in-person;
  • working with the graphic design team to ensure that orders are fulfilled, tracked, and correctly priced;
  • checking out customers during order pick-up and ensuring products are as ordered;
  • packaging and boxing printed materials;
  • filing and organizing work tickets;
  • and other tasks as assigned by the manager.
This is a full-time, temporary-to-direct hire position looking to hire immediately. This company will consider a direct-hire offer for the right candidate. The schedule will be Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. Pay is commensurate with experience.

Requirements:
  • Must be highly organized and able to multi-task.
  • Strong customer service skills are required.
  • Must have effective prioritization skills and able to keep deadlines.
  • Must possess strong computer skills and feel comfortable navigating a customer management database to create customer quotes.
  • Must have a respectful personality and the ability to work well with others in a tight-knit, team environment.
  • Candidates with knowledge of graphic design and Adobe Suite will be given preference.
  • Experience at a print shop is strongly preferred, but not required.

title: Production Supervisor
description:
Summary:
Our client is seeking a hands-on, people-focused Production Supervisor to lead one of their dynamic manufacturing departments. This supervisor role is ideal for someone with strong leadership qualities, a knack for problem-solving, and a passion for driving production excellence. You'll be responsible for managing daily operations, mentoring team members, and ensuring that quality and safety standards are consistently met.

📋 Key Responsibilities

  • Understand the fundamentals of filter production and their applications
  • Efficiently manage department operations to meet delivery timelines with minimal overtime
  • Read and interpret production reports and schedules to plan workflow
  • Schedule production using Oracle-based systems
  • Cross-train and rotate employees to build a flexible workforce
  • Train new hires and internal transfers
  • Conduct and document employee performance evaluations twice a year
  • Make personnel decisions and resolve customer service issues
  • Collaborate with other supervisors, HR, and support staff
  • Lead departmental Lean initiatives and participate in plant-wide projects
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard-free work environment
  • Enforce safety policies and ensure proper use of PPE
  • Monitor and enforce Lock-Out/Tag-Out procedures
  • Ensure all employees are trained and familiar with Best Work Practices (BWPs)
This is a temp-to-permanent, full-time position, hiring immediately. The schedule is first shift, Monday through Thursday, 6 a.m. to 3:00p and Friday, 6 a.m. to 12 p.m. Pay is $31/hour. If hired on directly, full benefits are available.

🧠 Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Fluent in English; bilingual in Spanish is a plus
  • Solid math and computer skills
  • Proven people management and time-management abilities
  • Ability to multitask and work independently or in teams
  • Forklift certification is helpful but not required
  • Able to read tape measures and understand fractions to 1/16 "
  • Physically capable of lifting up to 50 lbs and being on your feet most of the day

💼 Ideal Traits

  • Positive, cooperative, and dependable
  • Friendly and respectful with a team-building mindset
  • Honest, trustworthy, and decisive
  • Creative problem-solver with a proactive approach
  • Safety- and quality-minded with attention to detail
  • Flexible and resilient under production pressures

title: Controller
description:
Summary:
A controller needed for an established construction company specializing in underground utility projects based out of Athens, Ohio. They are looking for a self-motivated individual that is able to work with multiple accounting software programs to ensure proficient operation of daily accounting functions. Responsibilities include:
  • Payables/receivables
  • Payroll processing
  • Forecasting
  • Filing taxes
  • Renewals
  • End of year processing
  • Other accounting related projects
This is a direct-hire, full-time position, hiring immediately. The schedule is Monday through Friday, business hours. This is a salaried team member role and pay is commensurate with experience. This company does offer health insurance, PTO, and retirement benefits.

Qualifications:
  • Must have at least three years of related experience
  • Accounting education preferred, but not required
  • Must be a self-starter and be able to work well with deadlines
  • Accounting software proficiency
  • Prior experience working in the construction industry is highly desired

title: Production Specialist
description:
Summary:
We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Production Specialist to join our food manufacturing team in Nelsonville, Ohio. This role involves hands-on assembly line work and light sanitation duties to ensure a clean and efficient production environment. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced setting and take pride in maintaining high standards, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate on the assembly line to package and prepare food products.
  • Follow safety and quality control procedures throughout the production process.
  • Perform routine cleaning of workstations, equipment, and production areas.
  • Work in a friendly, respectful environment.
  • Collaborate with team members to meet daily production goals.
  • Other duties as assigned.
This is a temporary-to-direct, full-time position, hiring immediately. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., but schedule can change, and flexibility is needed. Pay starts at $16/hour. If hired on direct, benefits, including health insurance are available, as well as a $1/hr pay increase.

Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in food production or general manufacturing preferred.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods and perform repetitive tasks, the ability to lift 50 lbs.
  • Comfortable with cleaning duties as part of the daily routine.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to changing tasks.
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.

title: Material Handler
description:
A material handler is needed to support our client's warehouse and production teams in Lancaster, Ohio. If you're hands-on, detail-oriented, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

🛠️ Key Responsibilities:
  • Operate forklifts and electric pallet jacks (certification provided in-house)
  • Unload deliveries and transport materials to designated areas
  • Supply production lines with raw materials and retrieve empty pallets
  • Perform shipping and receiving duties when needed
  • Load outbound freight and inspect equipment
  • Maintain forklift batteries and propane tanks
  • Support safety protocols including PPE and Lock-Out/Tag-Out procedures
This is a temporary-to-direct, full-time position, hiring immediately. There are both first and second shift spots available. First shift is Mon through Fri, 6 AM to 2:30 PM and second shift is Mon through Thurs, 2:30 PM to 1 AM. Pay starts at $23.70 per hour. If hired on permanently, this company offers a full benefits package.

📚 Skills & Experience:
  • Basic math and tape measure skills (to 1/16 ")
  • Ability to read and write English for reports and work orders
  • Capable of lifting up to 50 lbs and using mechanical lifts for heavier loads
  • Comfortable working independently or as part of a team
  • Strong multitasking and time management abilities
💡 Ideal Traits:
  • Positive, cooperative attitude with strong communication skills
  • Dependable, punctual, and respectful
  • Safety- and quality-conscious with attention to detail
  • Adaptable to changing schedules and urgent material needs

title: Shipping and Receiving Associate
description:
Summary:
A Shipping & Receiving Associate needed for manufacturer in Lancaster, Ohio to become a vital part of their logistics team. This entry-level position is perfect for individuals who are eager to learn, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and are committed to accuracy, safety, and teamwork. You'll be trained in key operational systems and equipment, and cross-trained across shipping and receiving functions to support the smooth flow of goods in and out of our facility.

🔧 Key Responsibilities

Receiving Duties:

  • Operate forklifts (certification provided)
  • Use Oracle-Receiving module to process incoming goods
  • Unload, verify, and document raw material deliveries
  • Organize and transport materials to designated storage areas

Shipping Duties:

  • Operate hand scanners and label printers
  • Prepare Bills of Lading (BOLs) with accurate freight classifications
  • Load outbound shipments
  • Maintain shipping equipment and supplies

General Duties:

  • Perform equipment inspections and minor maintenance
  • Participate in inventory counts and Lean projects
  • Ensure safety compliance and proper use of PPE
  • Support cross-training and departmental flexibility
This is a temp-to-direct, full-time, second shift position, hiring immediately. The schedule is Monday through Thursday, 2:30 p.m. to 1 a.m. Rate of pay is $23.65 per hour. If hired on directly, full benefits are offered, including health insurance.

🧠 Skills & Qualifications

  • Basic computer and calculator proficiency
  • Strong math skills (including fractions and tape measure reading)
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and work on your feet throughout the day
  • Effective communication in English (verbal and written)
  • Prior forklift experience

🌟 Ideal Traits

  • Positive, cooperative, and respectful attitude
  • Self-motivated and dependable
  • Detail-oriented and safety-conscious
  • Flexible and able to adapt to changing schedules
  • Team player with leadership potential

title: Chemist
description:
Summary:
Chemist needed for a large manufacturer located in Gallipolis Ferry, West Virginia. Will assist the plant by:
  • Being accountable for performance to lab and plant goals.
  • Conduct product testing per sample/analysis plans. Which is typically for wastewater samples but can include raw materials, intermediate products, finished products, and technical service samples.
  • Maintain accurate and timely analysis reports, including entering data in various computer systems.
  • Maintain laboratory equipment including routine maintenance.
  • Complete daily SPC activities and use SPC principles and tools to identify problem areas and areas for improvement.
  • Dump all lab samples in approved containers and general upkeep of work area.
  • Retain laboratory samples.
  • Adhere to plant policies, especially Safety Rules and proper PPE.
  • Complete other projects as directed and all other tasks/duties as assigned.
This is a temporary, full-time position, hiring immediately and lasting two to three months, with a possible extension. Monday through Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Pay is $19/hour.

Qualifications/Skills Needed:
Required qualifications:
  • Associate degree in chemistry or related field.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment along with managing multiple projects/priorities/tasks simultaneously.
  • Motivated and ability to accurately perform large number of tests in a laboratory setting.
  • Understanding of common analytical instrumentation (ICP, pH meter, viscometer, spectrophotomer, colorimeter, densitometer, titrators, balances, resistivity meter, etc.)
  • Must be highly detail-oriented.
Preferred qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in chemistry or related field.
  • 1 to 3 years working as a lab tech or chemist.
  • Prior experience in a chemical manufacturing laboratory environment.
  • Preferred Computer skills – MS Office, Outlook, SAP, SPC statistical data.
* This employer operates a Drug Free Workplace Program.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Summary:

Administrative Assistant to the owner of a food production company located in Nelsonville, Ohio. Will be handling a wide variety of administrative work, including:

  • Creating/managing customer data and projects in company software
  • Entering orders and POs, and coordinating with customers and vendors
  • Taking admin projects off the desk of the CEO, and completing them with accuracy and professional communication
  • Assisting with detailed audit management work, among other ongoing projects

This is a temporary-to-direct, full-time position, hiring immediately. The pay is commensurate with experience, starting at $16/hr with increase to $18/hr on successful completion of probation period. Company offers full medical, dental, and vision benefits, as well as paid holidays and PTO. Plus it's a fun place to work, with a supportive, healthy work culture.

Qualifications:

  • At least two years of related experience.
  • Computer fluency is an absolute must. Will need to navigate documents and spreadsheets with ease while also learning custom company software.
  • Ability to write professional e-mails, and make calls on behalf of the company, is key.
  • Strong attention to detail and organization skills are necessary. Multitasking effectively is crucial.
  • Flexibility and a team-first mindset.
